return new Collector<Map.Entry<K,V>,M,M>(){@Override public Supplier<M>supplier(){return mapSupplier;}@Override public BiConsumer<M,Map.Entry<K,V>>accumulator(){return (map,entry)->map.put(entry.getKey(),entry.getValue());}@Override public BinaryOperator<M>combiner(){return (map,map2)->{map.putAll(map2);return map;};}@Override public Function<M,M>finisher(){return map->map;}@Override public Set<Characteristics>characteristics(){return EnumSet.of(Characteristics.UNORDERED,Characteristics.IDENTITY_FINISH);}};
